root_cause_of_the_new_blocker.distinct_from_pdfpy_02: A different causal stage (S8 coherence, not S6 per-task authoring) and a different mechanism. PDFPY-02's defect was an O(n^2) per-slot SCHEMA-enum explosion inside one batched task (`_type_batches` omitting `slot_facts`); it is landed, confirmed present in the code, and confirmed working live on this exact run (the types-1 call above). This new blocker is a whole-document, O(unit_count) PROMPT-and-completion size problem in a structurally different call: coherence_packet embeds the entire rendered README plus every non-batch unit's full existing text plus the union of every task's accepted facts, once per present run, by the module's own docstring 'the largest single section_authoring reply by construction' (composition/coherence.py lines 1-9, 96).
root_cause_of_the_new_blocker.related_but_separate_gap_not_the_primary: coherence_schema() (lines 87-107) binds only the outer `units` array's length (`minItems`/`maxItems` = existing_units count, item 75's own 2026-09-16 fix) and inherits item 75's static `text`/`omitted.reason` `maxLength` bounds from the manifest schema it deep-copies. It does NOT re-derive a per-unit `fact_ids` enum the way `authoring_schema()`'s per-task specialisation does via `citable()` - in coherence mode, every unit's `fact_ids` stays exactly the bare manifest schema (`prompts/section_authoring.yaml` line 79: `{type: array, minItems: 1, items: {type: string}}`, no `maxItems`, no `enum`). This is a real, independent structural asymmetry between the two call sites worth closing on its own merits, but it is not what is driving this truncation (the schema's own citation freedom does not by itself inflate prompt or completion size) and closing it alone would not fix the blocker measured above.

proposal.proposed_shape_options_not_prescribed: (a) Give the coherence call its own, larger max_output_tokens, distinct from the per-task authoring budget - not possible today without threading a per-call sampling override through render_messages/request_payload/run_job, since both call sites share one LoadedManifest. Distinguishable from the project's own standing 'raise max_output_tokens is not a fix' precedent (PDFPY-02, presentation_planning, source_reconciliation entries): those rejections targeted an UNBOUNDED array whose growth an output-budget raise only relocates to a larger repository; here the array (units) is ALREADY exactly bounded by item 75's own minItems=maxItems=len(existing_units) fix, so growth is a real, finite, proportional function of this repository's own authored content, not open-ended - though a large enough repository could still exceed any fixed raised budget, so this needs the loop-prompt.md section 3 rule (a threshold set from at least three measured compositions with a coherence pass, never fitted to this one sample) once two more repositories with a coherence call are measured. (b) Batch the coherence pass itself across multiple calls (mirroring _type_batches' own batching precedent, applied here instead of to type descriptions) - a real behavior change: cross-chunk voice/repetition consistency is no longer checked in one pass, so needs its own acceptance predicate if adopted. (c) Shrink the coherence prompt itself - e.g. skip re-sending rendered_document/existing_units text for sections plan.json's own deviations do not name as changed since the last coherence pass - changes what 'coherence' means (no longer truly whole-document) and needs its own test that a genuinely cross-section repetition is still caught. (d) Independently of whichever token-budget shape is chosen: add coherence_schema's own missing per-unit fact_ids enum (mirroring authoring_schema's citable() binding) so a coherence-mode unit cannot cite an out-of-scope fact id at the decoder level either - correct on its own merits but does not by itself resolve the truncation measured here.
proposal.explicitly_not_proposed: No relaxation of item 75's own units-array minItems/maxItems bound or its text maxLength=2200 - both are correct and stay exactly as strict. No blanket 'raise max_output_tokens globally' - see (a)'s own distinction above for why that precedent does not mechanically transfer here without a bounded, measured, per-job-shared-budget analysis first.
